tasks.title: Add shared stage evidence completion guard
tasks.description: Make WorkflowRun decide stage completion through one guard that compares StageDefinition promises with StageRun evidence. The guard must require matching successful static task runs, passed required check runs, successful terminal existing task runs, required approval, and must be used by both nextWork() and explicit completion paths.
acceptanceCriteria: A stage with declared static tasks cannot complete until each declared task has a matching successful terminal TaskRun
A stage with declared required checks cannot complete until each declared check has a current passed CheckRun
A stage with any existing pending, failed, or skipped TaskRun cannot complete even when no queued work remains
Required approval blocks stage completion until the StageRun approval state is approved
WorkflowRun.completeStage() or the equivalent explicit completion path returns the same blocked reason as nextWork() for incomplete evidence
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Keep the guard in the domain model and return structured recoverable reasons instead of relying on empty every(...) checks or throwing for evidence gaps.

tasks.title: Enforce Build dynamic work materialization evidence
tasks.description: Record Build dynamic task source evaluation in StageRun so missing, invalid, unevaluated, or zero-task tasks.json cannot look like a completed Build stage. Materialized tasks from tasks.json must be appended as run-owned TaskRun records and then participate in the shared completion guard.
acceptanceCriteria: Build cannot complete when its dynamic task source has not been evaluated
Missing tasks.json blocks Build completion with a clear workflow reason
Invalid tasks.json blocks Build completion with a clear workflow reason
A zero-task tasks.json blocks Build completion with a clear workflow reason
Valid tasks.json materializes one or more Build TaskRun records into StageRun.tasks without copying them into StageDefinition.tasks
Persisted and hydrated Build StageRun state preserves dynamic source evaluation status and materialized task evidence
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: The generated Build task identities belong only to the run. StageDefinition may describe the work source or policy, but must not become a generated task registry.

tasks.title: Require runtime-added task evidence
tasks.description: Make appended runtime work such as rebase, repair, or convergence tasks required for the current StageRun once created. Preserve reason or causedBy metadata on appended tasks and invalidate affected checks so stale check evidence cannot let the stage pass.
acceptanceCriteria: A runtime-added pending task prevents its stage from completing
A runtime-added failed or skipped task prevents its stage from completing
A runtime-added successful terminal task is accepted by the shared completion guard as run-owned evidence
Runtime-added tasks preserve reason or causedBy metadata that can be surfaced to users
Appending runtime work invalidates or replaces affected check runs so stale passed checks cannot satisfy completion
Runtime-added task kinds are not added as static StageDefinition.tasks
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Use the existing task/check boundaries: tasks perform work, checks verify it.

tasks.title: Require current Check review evidence
tasks.description: Make Check completion depend on current authoritative review and merge-readiness evidence rather than session status or absence of work. Approval should only be requestable or passable when the review task/result and required review or merge checks match the current candidate.
acceptanceCriteria: Check cannot complete without a successful current AI review task or equivalent authoritative review result for the current candidate
Check cannot complete without passed required review verdict checks
Check cannot complete without passed required merge-readiness checks
Stale Check task or check evidence is rejected after the candidate changes or runtime work invalidates the stage
A stale failed AgentSession does not block Check or Done when later task/check evidence proves success
A later successful AgentSession does not substitute for missing Check task/check evidence
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Completion truth should come from StageRun task/check evidence, not raw AgentSession.status.

tasks.title: Require Integrate delivery evidence before Done
tasks.description: Make Integrate the final workflow completion boundary by requiring its task, check, and delivery evidence before a workflow can pass or an issue can become Done. Integrate completion should prove the delivery steps finished successfully instead of relying on mergeState alone.
acceptanceCriteria: Workflow completion requires the run to reach and pass the final Integrate stage
Integrate cannot complete without successful required Integrate TaskRun evidence
Integrate cannot complete without passed required Integrate CheckRun evidence
Integrate cannot complete without delivery evidence such as spec sync or archive result, merge truth, and final health result according to the existing Integrate model
mergeState alone cannot mark a workflow passed or an issue Done when Integrate evidence is missing
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: This task consumes the shared guard and Check evidence semantics so final Done cannot bypass prior stage proof.

tasks.title: Harden Done projection against impossible snapshots
tasks.description: Keep WorkflowRunProjection defensive by rejecting impossible passed snapshots while avoiding stale session status or mergeState as authoritative completion truth. Projection should stay consistent with WorkflowRun evidence and surface inconsistency rather than inventing Done.
acceptanceCriteria: WorkflowRunProjection refuses a passed workflow snapshot that did not reach the final Integrate stage
WorkflowRunProjection refuses a passed workflow snapshot with missing final-stage completion evidence
Projection does not treat latest AgentSession failure as a hard Done blocker when later workflow task/check evidence is successful
Projection does not treat mergeState as sufficient to mark an issue Done when workflow evidence is incomplete
Impossible projection states produce a clear diagnostic or blocked projection result instead of silent Done
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Projection guards are diagnostic and defensive; the domain WorkflowRun remains the authoritative completion source.

tasks.title: Add completion evidence regression coverage
tasks.description: Add targeted regression tests proving workflow completion cannot be inferred from empty work, missing dynamic Build work, stale sessions, or impossible projections. The tests should cover the full invariant from domain nextWork() through explicit completion and projection paths.
acceptanceCriteria: Tests prove empty static stage work does not complete when the StageDefinition promises required tasks or checks that are missing from StageRun
Tests prove missing, invalid, and zero-task Build dynamic work sources block completion with clear reasons
Tests prove materialized Build tasks become required StageRun work for that run
Tests prove pending runtime-added tasks such as rebase-branch block stage completion and preserve reason or causedBy metadata
Tests prove Check cannot pass without current review and required review or merge check evidence
Tests prove Integrate cannot mark Done without required Integrate delivery evidence
Tests prove stale failed sessions do not prevent Done when later workflow evidence is successful
Tests prove impossible passed projection snapshots are rejected
Relevant backend test suites pass
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Prefer focused domain and service tests over broad end-to-end coverage unless an existing helper already makes the full path cheap to exercise.
